correctness.rationale: For odd \(|A|=m\), every element in the nontrivial coset of \(\operatorname{Dih}(A)\) is an involution, and each generates a distinct maximal cyclic subgroup of order \(2\), so the cyclic subgroup graph is exactly \(C(A)^*\) with \(m\) leaves added at the trivial subgroup. This proves \(\varepsilon(\operatorname{Dih}(A))=\varepsilon(A)+m\). The published theorem gives \(\varepsilon(A)\ge\varepsilon(C_m)\) with equality only for cyclic \(A\). The remaining inequality follows from the published coprime product formula and the proved bound \(\tau(m)+\varepsilon(C_m)\le m\), whose equality case is checked symbolically to be only \(m=3\).

value.rationale: The theorem verifies a named 2023 conjecture on an infinite class of even-order, nonnilpotent finite groups that is not covered by the conjecture source's theorem. It also gives an exact structural edge formula and a sharp equality classification, extending the ordinary-dihedral calculation from cyclic kernels to every odd abelian kernel.
